Rule package: checking the rules service…

🤖 What "Seal document with forensic report" does. Your document is analysed entirely on this device, in your browser, by the deterministic engine; its findings are stated as fact and anchored to quoted text on cited pages. Then the AI review runs on Cloudflare Workers AI: a short excerpt is classified for context, the findings are assessed before the report is built, Brain 9 reads the sealed page text (up to 16 windows of about 11,000 characters, pages without findings first) for anything the engine missed — every suggestion must quote the text verbatim or it is discarded — and the court-ready narrative is written section by section beside the technical report. Brain 9 recommendations are shown here and held outside the sealed reports; the verdict on any person is for the court.

What leaves this device for those steps: finding metadata — the type, severity and a short quote for each finding — plus text excerpts (up to 4,000 characters from the first pages for classification, up to 12,000 characters around the finding pages for the report narrative, the sealed page text in windows of about 11,000 characters for the Brain 9 sweep, and the pages the narrative sections cite); voice-note audio for transcription. Nothing is stored server-side; GPS, device and sealer identity are never sent. For privileged or sensitive matters choose Seal document instead: nothing leaves the device.

How Document Sealing Works

Every document sealed by Verum Omnis receives a forensic-grade cryptographic seal that makes it tamper-evident and court-admissible.

📜 A4 Watermark Background

The full-page Verum Omnis watermark is applied at 20% opacity behind your content. Your original document text is preserved exactly — the QR code sits in the natural page margin.

📱 Clean QR Code

QR sits in the top-right margin with white background panel — never covers document text. Original document layout is fully preserved. Scans instantly with any phone.

🔒 Dual Hash

SHA-256 for OpenTimestamps blockchain anchoring. SHA-512 as the Verum forensic fingerprint. Two independent hashes, zero trust required.

⛓ Bitcoin Blockchain

OpenTimestamps anchors the SHA-256 hash into Bitcoin. Once confirmed (~1-2 hours), the timestamp is permanently and independently verifiable.

👤 Identity Pipeline

Optional sender identity (name, ID, address, email) is written into your private Seal Certificate for affidavit pre-fill and chain of custody — never into the public QR code unless you explicitly opt in.

📍 GPS + Device

Automatic geolocation and device fingerprint capture. Proves where and from what device the seal was applied.

🔐 Password Protection

Optional AES-256 password protection with delivery receipt cover page. Recipient must email sender for password — that email IS the read receipt.

🛡 Tamper Detection

Recipient uploads document to verify page. If SHA-512 doesn't match --> "TAMPERED — DO NOT ACCEPT". Cryptographically impossible to forge.
